label_shuffle_dev_check.description: Model C fitted on shuffled inner-training labels, scored on the inner-validation year (development data only; no test data involved). Expect no improvement over a constant.

logistic_l2:A vs constant:constant.convention: metric(logistic_l2:A) - metric(constant:constant); negative Brier/log-loss favours logistic_l2:A

logistic_l2:B vs logistic_l2:A.convention: metric(logistic_l2:B) - metric(logistic_l2:A); negative Brier/log-loss favours logistic_l2:B

logistic_l2:B+dictionary vs logistic_l2:.convention: metric(logistic_l2:B+dictionary) - metric(logistic_l2:B); negative Brier/log-loss favours logistic_l2:B+dictionary

logistic_l2:B+length vs logistic_l2:B.convention: metric(logistic_l2:B+length) - metric(logistic_l2:B); negative Brier/log-loss favours logistic_l2:B+length

logistic_l2:B+paragraph_change vs logist.convention: metric(logistic_l2:B+paragraph_change) - metric(logistic_l2:B); negative Brier/log-loss favours logistic_l2:B+paragraph_change

logistic_l2:C vs constant:constant.convention: metric(logistic_l2:C) - metric(constant:constant); negative Brier/log-loss favours logistic_l2:C

logistic_l2:C vs logistic_l2:B.convention: metric(logistic_l2:C) - metric(logistic_l2:B); negative Brier/log-loss favours logistic_l2:C

logistic_l2:C vs logistic_l2:B (company.convention: metric(logistic_l2:C) - metric(logistic_l2:B); negative Brier/log-loss favours logistic_l2:C

logistic_l2:C vs logistic_l2:B (uncalibr.convention: metric(C_raw) - metric(B_raw); negative Brier/log-loss favours C_raw

primary.comparison: Delta Brier = Brier(C) - Brier(B), calibrated logistic models, pooled out-of-time; negative favours text

scope: pooled out-of-time predictions across all ready annual folds (each event scored once, by the model of its own test year)
